children: Egyptian developer New Plan Developments will deliver 1,700 units in 2026 backed by construction allocation of approximately 2.5 billion Egyptian pounds ($47.8 million), Chairman Walid Khalil told Zawya Projects.
The planned handovers would take the company's cumulative deliveries to around 3,100 units, comprising approximately 2,500 units in the NAC and 600 units in Port Said.
Khalil said construction spending remains a priority for the developer as buyers increasingly consider project execution and delivery when making purchasing decisions.
New Plan's portfolio comprises nine projects across the NAC, New Cairo, Port Said and the North Coast, spanning residential, commercial, administrative and hospitality developments.
The company has delivered Serrano and the first phases of Eleven, Atika and Talla, as well as Eclat Residence in Port Said, which is operational.
Construction is underway at Amara and Sadaf, while the remaining phases of its projects are progressing according to their targeted schedules.
New Plan is targeting EGP6 billion ($114.8 million) in sales in 2026, alongside continued construction across its existing portfolio.
Khalil said Serrano, Eleven, Atika and Eclat have achieved sales rates of 99 percent, while Granvia has reached 80 percent, Talla 70 percent, Amara 60 percent and Lamborghini 50 percent.
Sadaf, which was launched in 2026, has recorded sales of around 25 percent.

The developer is also evaluating expansion opportunities in Sheikh Zayed and the Red Sea region, as it seeks to add projects selectively while balancing portfolio growth with construction activity and financing capacity.
“New Plan Developments’ expansion strategy is closely linked to its ability to maintain a balanced equation between portfolio size, construction activity, and financing capacity,” Khalil concluded.
(Reporting by Eman Hamed; Editing by Anoop Menon)
